assumptions: Each change is a separate simulation of the scenario with one parameter doubled or halved, or one choice switched; the simulator's own assumptions apply to each run.
Pairs of the first 8 changes that are not protocol switches are also simulated together, since two limits can coincide; larger combinations are not tried.

The opportunistic policy tried uses 60 % of the cycle and a 10 µs master turnaround; a PDO channel tried in place of a mailbox protocol carries 256 B per cycle with a window of 2. These are model choices, not properties of a particular master.
Whether a slave or master supports a change (a faster SPI clock, larger mailboxes, another protocol) is not checked beyond the ESC RAM the SyncManagers need.
A change within 1 % of the scenario's time counts as having no effect; a pair is listed when it beats both of its parts alone, and the scenario, by more than that.
